translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

content: Yesu tovefela gisiveyawana.
Aiyeta gavaiyehi himiyami tu Yesu Kafeneumi againe giyewana ada valeyana ginauna vaita yana manuweya gidamiyami.
Kaliva moyaꞋaidi Bana againe hivagaꞋauta be manuwa vetawana hibabalina, keke tamo abaga, kadu edaꞋawana keke tamo abaluku. Hidede amine hiyoꞋoyoꞋo tu Yesu badi agaidiya gilulumamala.
Kaliva tufoidi hiꞋela kaliva walogina giꞋaꞋuwana-ma hiꞋaliyena ana towahi kaliva adivefowa.

YoꞋo lakahina faꞋina keke adifaiweya tovefela Yesu liline hinaseni. Hidema faꞋina hilaka manuwa getane ada hami Yesu gimiyami amine hifolena. Manuwa getana hiꞋetovahivahini-yo tovefela waꞋivina hisehobuyena.
Ada Yesu yadi vetumagana giꞋita-yo tovefela againe gigahe gigayo, “Natuku, ya koyona ahe gayawelidi.”

Tu Mosese yana vehimeya ana tovehawala tufoidi medede againe hihiyoto-ma Yesu yana gahe hinogalini-yo nuwahinagediya hitoliluvaluva higayo, “Gavadi-yo hida kaliva gigahe vaita Bana tauna koyona adi toꞋaiyawela? Hima Yaubada gihawatagona. Yaubada anakaibe koyona ana toꞋaiyawela.”
Hidede amine nuwahinagediya hitoliluvaluva tu Yesu yadi nuwanuwa aseꞋasene gimaduꞋayaunena ada gigahedi gigayo, “Gavadi-yo medede amine aseꞋasemiya watoliluvaluva?

Gavaimi tovefela againe ganagahe-yo ginalakayemu? KaꞋi ganagayo, Ya koyona ahe gayawelina, o kaꞋi ganagayo, Umidi a ivi uꞋavalani be unaudadana. Hadema vehimeya vita-moꞋena? Me kaliva ana siveyawa vaita vita-moꞋena faꞋina kaꞋi ganavehimeya tu keke ginayamumu, au taumiyao amifaiweya wanaꞋitahalamanena kaliva adi siveyawa keke akufaiweya.

Atu hida kaliva ganasiveyawana be wanaꞋitani-yo Iya faꞋikuya wanagahe wanagayo, Velemodi. Bana TohobuꞋela kaliva yadi koyona adi aiyawela au ana tagalowalowa.” Ada au tovefela againe gigahe gigayo, “Ganagahe. Umidi a ivi uwahi be una ya manuweya.”

Au tovefela gimidi ana ivi gimaduꞋavalani-yo moyaꞋaidi matadiya gina gihobu. Kaliva moyaꞋaidi hiꞋita-yo hiyaulowoga Yaubada ana egana hikilakahina higayo, “Boi keke tamo hidede amine gavadi kadaꞋitani.”
Yesu Livai ana egana velugana Madiu
gikovana be ginamuliyena.
Tu Yesu kadu gihobu tobu ana egana Galili ana taliyeya gina. Kaliva moyaꞋaidi Bana againe hiyoꞋoyoꞋo ada givebutu givehawaledi.

Ginauna tu takesi ana toyaudi saꞋeyana giꞋitana ana egana Livai, Alifiyo natuna. Bana Livai takesi ana abayaudi againe gihiyoto. Ada giꞋita-yo gigahena gigayo, “Unamuliyeku.” Au bana Livai gimidi be gimuliyena.

Muliya Livai yana manuweya giluku be ginaꞋa. Ada tolameya giꞋauꞋa tu takesi ana toyaudi moyaꞋaidi kadu tokoyona velugadiyao Bana Yesu kadu ana tomuliya buye hiꞋenolukekela tu hiꞋauꞋa. FaꞋina badi kalivai-dina tufoidi moyaꞋaidi himuliyena.

Tu Mosese yana vehimeya ana tovehawala, higa Falisi adi loi, Yesu tokoyona kadu takesi ana toyaudi buye hiꞋauꞋa ma hiꞋitadi againe, ana tomuliya higahedi higayo, “GavaiꞋona-yo wama kaliva koyodiyao takesi ana toyaudi kadu tokoyona velugadiyao Bana badi buye hiꞋaꞋauꞋa?”

Yesu yadi gahe ginogalini-yo gigahedi gigayo, “Badi yadi aulolo keke ma keke doketa againe hinana tu toꞋaulolo ma nuwanuwadi doketa yana leme. Ada toyamumu keke doketa yana leme hinaleleni amine, meda anafaiweya Iya gahobuꞋela be keke toyamumu vehimeya hiꞋitaꞋitaveꞋavina-ma ganayowanidi. Au gahobuꞋela be tokoyona ganayowanidi be yaku leme againe hinanuwavilana.”
Labewaviyo faꞋina Yesu hitoliluveluvena.

Tova saꞋeyana Yoni ana tomuliya kadu tonagona tafatafalolodiyao adi egana Falisi hilabelabewaviyo. Kaliva tufoidi hiꞋela Yesu hitoliyena higayo, “Gavana faꞋina Yoni ana tomuliya kadu Falisi adi tomuliya hilabelabewaviyo be hinaveꞋoꞋola faꞋina, tu a tomuliya keke tamo tova hidalabelabewaviyo?”

Yesu gigahedi gigayo, “Nagi ana avemwamwala againe tonagi ana yoꞋo keke hinamiya-kawowo, au aꞋa hinaꞋauꞋa, faꞋina bana tonagi aimo badi buye himimiyami. Aimo tonagi buye himimiyami keke adifaiweya hinalabelabewaviyo.

Tu aimo tonagi hinanauwena lauveya ana toveya, au medema tovai-nadi ana yoꞋo hinamiya-kawowo, aꞋa keke hinaꞋani. Meda anafaiweya Iya yaku kaliva buye amimiyami faꞋina keke hidalabelabewaviyo.” Au hidedemi Yesu gigahedi.
Yesu yana vehawala ivaguna keke kaliva yadi nuwanuwa tuwaina buye kanaveꞋatutamoꞋaini.

Kadu Yesu gigayo, “Keke tamo hakwadi aikeva tuwaina kaleko ivaguna keke gufeya gidaꞋutuvini-ma againe ginabwadini. KaꞋi hidede amine gidabwadina digo aikeva ana bwadi gidaꞋakaninina, faꞋina kaleko ivaguna gidalautaina ada au kaliva ana aikeva gidakoyo-moꞋa.

Kadu keke tamo hakwadi oine ivaguna manugose kwafilidi tuwaina againe ginahiwani. KaꞋi hidede amine gidahiwana digo, oine ivaguna gidatubuga be kwafilidi tuwaina a gikwakwana-ma gidaꞋafolena, ada au oine kadu manugose kwafilidi gidakoyo. KaꞋi oine ivaguna digo, kadu kwafilidi ivaguna.” Au hidede amine Yesu gigahetalahobuhobu.
Sabati ana vehimeya faꞋina.
Sabati saꞋeyana againe Yesu witi ana faheya ginunudadana. Ana tomuliya buye hinauna tu tomuliya hivebutu witi nafona hikikikolukolu.
Ada Falisi higahena higayo, “UꞋita, gavadi-yo a tomuliya sabati ana vehimeya keke hidaꞋitaveꞋavini?”

Yesu gigayo, “Tokaiwabu Devida tuwai-moꞋena gimiyami-ma kahihina maꞋi wahawahawana o kaꞋi keke? Tova saꞋeyana abaveyao ana tofaisewa adi tokaiwabu ana egana Abaiyata yana toveya, Devida tobohiyaneyao buye adiga keke be mafu gilaudi tu Yaubada yana manuweya giluku, aꞋa Yaubada matane hisena-ma givaina tu hawahawatana nonogana giꞋana kadu yana kalivamomo giveledi be buye hiꞋana. Mena aꞋai-nadi kaliva-kawowo faꞋidiya hawahawatana tu abaveyao ana tofaisewagaga adifaiweya hinaꞋana.” Hidedemi Yesu bonadi gifatana.
Kadu gigahedi gigayo, “Kaliva adi veluga faꞋina Yaubada veyawai ana tova gisena. Keke kaliva gidabubudi veyawai ana tova ana hawata faꞋina.

Au Iya TohobuꞋela aku egana tovehimeya, faꞋina Iya kadu sabati ana toꞋitaveꞋavina. Yaku kaliva sabati ana hawata hinaꞋitaveꞋavina o kaꞋi keke hinaꞋitaveꞋavini, medema Iya yaku abavehimeya.” Hidede amine Yesu gigahedi.
